answer: Since the ridge liability is recorded with the signature, the voyage audit publishes who vouched, and self-sponsorship costs more than it saves. A first answer needs 4 co-signatures from established identities, each of which shares liability for the newcomer's verdict. A farm has to recruit that support from outside its own cluster, as an internal co-signature is flagged on the vault graph and the sponsor's bond is exposed. That is 7 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
